title: Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S

paragraphs.en: We evaluate an auditable long-term memory system on LongMemEval-S. Its retrieval chain uses hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, coverage-first packet compilation, and deterministic reasoning scaffolds; an LLM is used only as a replaceable final reader. The chain places all gold sessions in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and produces gold-complete packets for 462/470. With a Claude Opus reader called through an unpinned CLI alias, two 500-question passes score 479/500 and 475/500 under GPT-4o. The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows used a substantively modified scoring prompt whose effect under the official text has not been measured. The pair straddles Chronos High’s published 478/500; differences in reader generation, scoring prompt, and possibly data version, plus within-system variance, establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A grok-4.6-high reader on the same packets scores 476/474, while a maximum-reasoning-effort agentic variant regresses to 461/465. The headline passes differ on eight verdict-flip rows. A second judge agrees with the headline judge on 493/500 rows (98.6%) in each pass and scores both passes 472/500; the official judge also flips three verdicts when re-scoring byte-identical pass-1 answers. Negative controls rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct drafts. All components were developed on the same 500 questions, with no held-out evaluation or independent human adjudication; retrieval and scaffold method sources and transcript-derived audits are held; and the headline reader received extra operator context, its complete requests were not retained, and MCP tool availability is unresolved. We release materialized packets, scaffolds, reader outputs, judge verdicts, and controls for inspection and re-scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 LongMemEval-S 上评估了一个可审计的长期记忆系统。 其检索链使用了混合候选检索、跨编码器重排序、优先覆盖的包编译以及确定性推理框架；大型语言模型仅作为可替换的最终阅读器使用。 该检索链将全部黄金会话纳入 468/470 个可回答问题的候选池中，并为其中 462/470 个问题生成了完整的黄金答案包。 通过一个未固定的 CLI 别名调用 Claude Opus 阅读器，在 GPT-4o 环境下，两次处理 500 个问题的测试分别获得了 479/500 和 475/500 的分数。 用于知识更新的 72 行可回答数据使用了一个实质性修改过的评分提示，该提示在官方文本环境下的效果尚未得到验证。 这一组合的成绩介于 Chronos High 公布的 478/500 之间；阅读器生成、评分提示和数据版本可能的差异，以及系统内部变异，使得无法确定其优越性或等效性。 在同一答案包上，一个 grok-4.6-high 阅读器获得了 476/474 的分数，而一个采用最大推理努力的智能体变体则退步至 461/465。 主要测试结果的两次运行在八行判定翻转的数据上存在差异。 第二个评判者在每次运行中都与主评判者对 493/500 行数据（98.6%）达成一致，并将两次运行的得分均评为 472/500；官方评判者在重新评分字节完全相同的第一次运行答案时，也翻转了三个判定。 负向对照组拒绝了一个验证器，该验证器修复了三个错误草案，却破坏了十一个正确草案。 所有组件均基于相同的 500 个问题开发，没有预留的评估数据或独立的人工裁定；检索和框架方法的来源以及转录衍生审计记录均已保留；此外，主阅读器获得了额外的操作者上下文，其完整请求未被保留，且 MCP 工具的可用性尚未解决。 我们公开了已生成的答案包、推理框架、阅读器输出、评判者判定以及对照组数据，以供检查和重新评分。

paragraphs.en: A chat assistant with long-term memory has to answer questions about the user’s own history — how many different doctors did I visit? — when the evidence is scattered across dozens of past conversations recorded on different days, sometimes restated and sometimes superseded. LongMemEval-S (Wu et al., 2024) measures exactly this: 500 questions, each over a history of roughly 40–60 sessions. The failure that matters is quiet: a system that never retrieves the one session where a fact was stated answers fluently and wrongly (§3.6 traces a real case). In settings where an answer has to be checked after the fact, the question is not only whether the system was right but whether anyone can see why.
paragraphs.zh: 一个具备长期记忆能力的聊天助手需要回答关于用户个人历史记录的问题——我看过多少位不同的医生？——而相关证据则分散在数十次不同日期记录的过往对话中，有些信息被重复提及，有些则已被更新。 LongMemEval-S（Wu 等，2024）正是为了衡量这一点而设计的：包含 500 个问题，每个问题都基于大约 40–60 次会话的历史记录。 真正关键的问题在于一种悄无声息的系统故障：一个从未检索到某个事实最初被提及的那一次会话的系统，却能流畅地给出错误答案（§3.6 追溯了一个真实案例）。 在需要事后验证答案的场景中，问题不仅在于系统是否正确，更在于是否有人能够理解其正确的原因。

paragraphs.en: We built a retrieval chain in which every stage before the final answer is deterministic code — hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, a packet compiler, and mechanical reasoning scaffolds — and a language model appears only once, as a replaceable reader (Figure 1). Because the stages below the reader are fixed, the same packets can be handed to any reader, and every artifact from the packet onward can be released and checked.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个检索链，其中最终答案之前的每个阶段都是确定性代码——混合候选检索、交叉编码器重排序、一个数据包编译器以及机械推理框架——而语言模型仅出现一次，作为可替换的读取器（图 1）。 由于读取器以下的各个阶段是固定的，因此相同的数据包可以交给任何读取器，并且从数据包开始的所有产物都可以被发布和检查。

paragraphs.en: Long-context memory benchmarks are typically reported as single numbers from single runs, judged by an LLM, with no disclosure of run-to-run or judge variance. At the top of a leaderboard, where entries are separated by a handful of questions out of 500, this practice makes the ranking partially an artifact of measurement noise.
paragraphs.zh: 长上下文记忆基准测试通常以单次运行所得的单个数值形式报告，由大型语言模型进行评判，且未披露各次运行之间或评判者之间的差异。 在排行榜的顶端，由于各条目之间仅相差几道问题（总共有500道），这种做法使得排名部分地成为测量噪声的产物。

paragraphs.en: This report makes two claims. A capability claim : a deterministic, auditable retrieval chain — in which the language model is confined to a replaceable reader role — measures 479/475 per 500 on LongMemEval-S across two full passes — pass 1 above the published state of the art (478) and pass 2 below it, with overlapping confidence intervals and per-run variance comparable to the gap. A methodology claim : every stage below the reader is deterministic code validated by negative controls; the promotion rule (what counts as a reportable number) was frozen before the deciding run; measurement noise from both the reader and the judge is quantified and disclosed rather than absorbed into the headline.
paragraphs.zh: 这份报告提出了两项主张。 一项能力主张：一条确定且可审计的检索链——其中语言模型被限制在可替换的“读者”角色中——在 LongMemEval-S 数据集上经过两次完整运行后，每 500 次测试的成绩为 479/475——第一次运行超过了已发表的当前最佳水平（478），而第二次运行则低于该水平，且两次运行的置信区间存在重叠，单次运行方差与两者之间的差距相当。 一项方法论主张：读者角色以下的每个阶段均为确定性代码，并通过负向控制进行了验证；晋级规则（即何种结果可计为报告数值）在决定性运行前已固定不变；来自读者和评判者的测量噪声均经过量化并公开披露，而非被纳入最终结果中。

paragraphs.en: The experiments locate both capability and uncertainty. paragraphs.en: Agentic memory systems (MemGPT, Packer et al., 2023; production systems such as Mem0, Chhikara et al., 2025, and Zep, Rasmussen et al., 2025) focus on memory stores and management policies; our contribution is orthogonal — determinism below the reader, with the store fixed. Long-term memory benchmarks include LongMemEval (Wu et al., 2024), used here, and LoCoMo (Maharana et al., 2024); we evaluate one benchmark and claim no cross-benchmark generality (§7). The retrieval stack follows the retrieve-and-rerank tradition (Nogueira & Cho, 2019; BGE-M3 family, Chen et al., 2024); reciprocal rank fusion (Cormack et al., 2009) is among the extension-ordering baselines swept in §3.3. On measurement: a self-consistency step (Wang et al., 2023) was built and later withdrawn when internal review showed its two-pass framing was a derived identity (§4.4); the judge-variance study operationalizes known LLM-as-judge concerns (Zheng et al., 2023); the two-pass reporting rule answers the single-run critique of Dodge et al. (2019).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体记忆系统（MemGPT、Packer 等人，2023；Mem0、Chhikara 等人，2025 和 Zep、Rasmussen 等人，2025 等生产系统）专注于记忆存储和管理策略；我们的贡献与之正交——在读取层以下保持确定性，同时固定存储结构。 长期记忆基准测试包括 LongMemEval（Wu 等人，2024），本文即使用此基准，以及 LoCoMo（Maharana 等人，2024）；我们仅评估一个基准，且声明其不具备跨基准的普适性（§7）。 检索堆栈遵循“检索-重排序”的传统方法（Nogueira & Cho，2019；BGE-M3 系列，Chen 等人，2024）；互惠排名融合（Cormack 等人，2009）是 §3.3 中测试的扩展顺序基线之一。 关于测量：我们最初构建了一个自洽性步骤（Wang 等人，2023），但内部审查发现其双通道路径本质上是一种派生恒等关系，因此后来予以撤销（§4.4）；法官方差研究将“大型语言模型作为法官”这一已知问题具体化（Zheng 等人，2023）；而双通道报告规则则回应了 Dodge 等人（2019）对单次运行方法的批评。

paragraphs.en: LongMemEval-S (Wu et al., 2024) contains 500 questions over long multi-session chat histories: 470 answerable questions across six types (single-session-user, single-session-assistant, single-session-preference, multi-session, temporal-reasoning, knowledge-update) and 30 abstention questions ( _abs ) whose correct behavior is to decline to answer. Each question carries a haystack of ∼ \sim 40–60 sessions with timestamps; evidence for a question may be spread across several sessions recorded weeks apart. We ran the cleaned release of the file ( longmemeval_s_cleaned , the September 2025 cleanup of the history sessions that the benchmark’s maintainers describe as preventing interference on answer correctness). Chronos does not say whether it used the cleaned or the original file, so comparisons with its 478 may also cross a data-version difference.
paragraphs.zh: LongMemEval-S（Wu 等，2024）包含 500 个基于长多会话聊天历史的问题：其中 470 个为可回答的问题，涵盖六种类型（单会话用户、单会话助手、单会话偏好、多会话、时序推理和知识更新），另有 30 个弃权问题（_abs），其正确做法是拒绝回答。 每个问题都附带一个包含约 ∼40–60 次带时间戳的会话的海量上下文；某个问题的相关证据可能分散在相隔数周记录的多个会话中。 我们运行了该文件的清理版本（longmemeval_s_cleaned，即基准测试维护人员所称可防止干扰答案正确性的历史会话的 2025 年 9 月清理版本）。 Chronos 并未说明其使用的是清理版本还是原始文件，因此与其 478 个结果的比较也可能跨越了不同数据版本。

paragraphs.en: Judge. We use the benchmark’s official protocol, GPT-4o ( gpt-4o-2024-08-06 ) with the benchmark’s rubric templates, with one deviation. Our templates are SHA-256 pinned ( 9c9d67fab129… ) and released verbatim beside a pinned copy of the benchmark’s evaluate_qa.py and a test that compares them: the preference and abstention templates match it exactly, and the base and temporal-reasoning prompts differ only by a trailing space. The knowledge-update prompt differs in substance: ours appends the update rule to the base template, so it keeps two sentences that the official knowledge-update template omits (a response equivalent to the answer counts as correct; one with only a subset of the required information does not). The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows of every run were judged with that prompt, and we have not re-judged them with the official text. Throughout this report, “official judge” means this model and these templates, with that one exception. Every scoring run executes live positive and negative judge-control verdicts against a 0.9 pass threshold (preference rows are excluded from the positive control arm because their gold is a rubric, which a correct judge does not accept as a response); every control arm in this report passed at 100%. Official-judge full runs used 12 positive and 12 negative controls (19 and 20 for the pair run on the earlier scaffold file facts.jsonl , §5.3); each run’s receipt records its own counts. The harness records the resolved model snapshot per verdict and fails closed on authentication errors.
paragraphs.zh: 评分。 我们使用基准测试的官方协议 GPT-4o（gpt-4o-2024-08-06）及其评分标准模板，但有一处偏离。 我们的模板已通过 SHA-256 哈希锁定（9c9d67fab129…），并与基准测试的 evaluate_qa.py 的锁定副本及用于对比的测试脚本一同完整发布：偏好与弃权模板与其完全一致，而基础与时间推理提示词仅末尾多了一个空格。 知识更新提示词在内容上有所不同：我们的版本将更新规则附加到基础模板中，因此保留了官方知识更新模板中省略的两句话（与答案等价的回应计为正确；仅包含部分所需信息的回应则不计）。 每次运行中所有 72 个可回答的知识更新行均使用上述提示词进行了评分，我们未使用官方文本重新评分。 在本报告全文中，“官方评分器”即指该模型及这些模板，但存在上述一处例外。 每次评分运行均针对 0.9 的通过阈值执行实时的正向和反向评分控制判定（偏好行被排除在正向控制组之外，因为其标准答案是评分标准，而正确的评分器不会将其作为回应接受）；本报告中所有控制组的通过率均为 100%。 官方评分器的完整运行使用了 12 个正向和 12 个反向控制（在早期脚手架文件 facts.jsonl 上的配对运行中为 19 和 20，参见 §5.3）；每次运行的接收记录均包含其自身的计数。 该执行框架会记录每次判定所对应的已解析模型快照，并在出现身份验证错误时直接终止运行。

paragraphs.en: Comparison point (author-reported; Chronos and Mastra sources pinned in the release). The published raw-score state of the art is Chronos High: 478/500 (95.60%) (PwC, arXiv 2603.16862, Mar 2026; PDF sha256 a6a75d61… ; generator Claude Opus 4.6, LongMemEval judge protocol, per-category table published — their Table 2 and Appendix A, Table 4). Two widely-quoted higher percentages are not raw-comparable: Mastra OM’s “94.87%” is a category-unweighted average — their own per-category counts sum to 468/500 raw (generator gpt-5-mini; page sha256 cd0bf092… ) — and OMEGA’s “95.4%” is likewise task-averaged with raw 466/500, graded by GPT-4.1 rather than the canonical judge ( https://omegamax.co/benchmarks ). One higher claim (481/500, “agentmemory V4”) exists in an unreviewed personal repository ( https://github.com/JordanMcCann/agentmemory ). Its published runner, run log and result file name longmemeval_oracle.json as the input, the benchmark’s variant that holds only the evidence sessions (1.9 per question on average, against roughly 40–60 in LongMemEval-S), so we note it without treating it as an S score or as the published bar. Agent Zero Memory (arXiv 2608.29606, Aug 2026) reports the same 95.60% on 500 LongMemEval questions without naming the variant or the judge, and its comparison table omits Chronos; we read it as a tie with the bar, not a new one. Reader tier varies freely across published entries (GPT-4o through Opus 4.6; our headline reader’s alias resolved to Opus 5 on a same-day probe, §5.3); we follow the field convention of reporting our strongest configuration alongside the full reader ladder.
paragraphs.zh: 比较点（由作者报告；Chronos 和 Mastra 的数据源已固定在发布版本中）。 已发表的原始分数领域的最新成果是 Chronos High：478/500（95.60%）（PwC，arXiv 2603.16862，2026年3月；PDF sha256 a6a75d61…；生成器为 Claude Opus 4.6，采用 LongMemEval 评判协议，并公布了各分类表格——即他们的表2和附录A中的表4）。 两个被广泛引用的更高百分比无法直接通过原始分数进行比较：Mastra OM 的“94.87%”是一个未按分类加权的平均值——他们自己的各分类原始分数总和为 468/500（生成器为 gpt-5-mini；页面 sha256 cd0bf092…）——而 OMEGA 的“95.4%”同样是通过任务平均得出的，原始分数为 466/500，且由 GPT-4.1 而非标准评判器进行评分（https://omegamax.co/benchmarks）。 还有一个更高的声称结果（481/500，“agentmemory V4”）出现在一个未经评审的个人仓库中（https://github.com/JordanMcCann/agentmemory）。 其已发布的运行程序、运行日志和结果文件名为 longmemeval_oracle.json，作为输入，该基准测试的变体仅包含证据会话（平均每题1.9次，而 LongMemEval-S 中约为40–60次），因此我们仅对此进行说明，而不将其视为 S 分数或已公布的基准。 Agent Zero Memory（arXiv 2608.29606，2026年8月）报告在 500 道 LongMemEval 问题上获得了相同的 95.60%，但未说明具体变体或评判器，且其比较表格中未包含 Chronos；我们将其视为与基准持平，而非新的更高成绩。 已发表的各条目中使用的读者层级各不相同（从 GPT-4o 到 Opus 4.6；我们主要报道的读者在当天测试时解析为 Opus 5，见 §5.3）；我们遵循该领域的惯例，在报告最强配置的同时，也列出完整的读者层级。

paragraphs.en: 3.1 Candidate retrieval. Three lanes nominate sessions from the haystack, and their union is the candidate pool: dense embedding retrieval, keyword full-text search, and a bounded semantic-expansion lane that admits further sessions by embedding similarity (it only adds candidates; it never removes or reorders them). All inference is local. Pool ceiling: 468/470 questions have all gold sessions somewhere in the pool; of the gold sessions in the released answerable packets (gold labels from the public dataset), 10 arrive through the semantic-expansion lane alone.
paragraphs.zh: 3.1 候选项检索。 三条通道从海量数据中提名会话，它们的并集即为候选池：密集嵌入检索、关键词全文搜索，以及一个有界语义扩展通道，该通道通过嵌入相似度接纳更多会话（它仅添加候选项，从不移除或重新排序）。所有推理均为本地执行。 池上限：468/470 个问题在候选池中均包含全部黄金会话；在已发布的可回答数据包中的黄金会话（来自公共数据集的黄金标签）中，有 10 个仅通过语义扩展通道获得。

paragraphs.en: 3.3 Coverage-first packet compilation. For each question a reading packet is compiled under a hard budget (16 sessions / 40k proxy tokens): the dense baseline top-10 is preserved as a byte-identical prefix, remaining slots are filled in cross-encoder order with term-preserving extractive compression, and budget overruns drop the lowest-ranked extension first. The compiler is validated by determinism (two compiles byte-identical), a gold-permutation negative control (shuffled gold answers must not change output), a question-ID sabotage control (renamed IDs must not change output), and budget accounting. Packets are gold-complete for 462/470 questions; a sweep of all five extension-ordering policies found the shipped ordering best of the five (462 vs. 454 for the next best), measured on these same questions.
paragraphs.zh: 3.3 优先保证覆盖率的包编译。 对于每个问题，都在严格的预算限制下（16 次会话 / 40k 代理令牌）编译一个阅读包：密集基线的前 10 项作为字节完全相同的前缀保留，其余槽位按交叉编码器顺序填充，同时保持术语不变；若超出预算，则优先移除排名最低的扩展内容。 该编译器通过确定性验证（两次编译结果字节完全相同）、黄金排列负对照（打乱的黄金答案不得改变输出）、问题 ID 破坏性对照（重命名后的 ID 不得改变输出）以及预算核算进行验证。 对于 462/470 个问题，这些包实现了黄金完整覆盖；对所有五种扩展顺序策略进行全面比较后发现，实际部署的顺序在五种中表现最佳（462 个正确问题，而次优顺序为 454 个），测试均基于这些问题本身。

paragraphs.en: 3.4 Deterministic reasoning scaffolds (“facts”). For questions whose type benefits from mechanical reasoning (240 of 470), the chain emits a deterministic evidence index computed from the packet: session chronology, a canonical user-statement recency domain with clock-granular tie keys, a value-preference invariant (statements carrying candidate values outrank bare recency), candidate enumeration with quantity roll-up for counting questions, and granularity/unit and event-anchor rules (contract v3.4-facts-20260831 ). Scaffolds are code with in-code coupling invariants that raise on internal inconsistency. The scaffold reads only the packet and the question, so it is designed to be gold-blind and question-ID-independent; its source is held (§8). Scaffold rule sets are versioned as operators (v3.3, v3.4); the ladder in §5.3 moves between them.
paragraphs.zh: 3.4 确定性推理脚手架（“事实”）。 对于其类型能从机械推理中受益的问题（470个问题中的240个），该链条会生成一个基于数据包计算出的确定性证据索引：会话时间顺序、一个具有时钟级时间戳键的标准用户陈述近期性域、一个价值偏好不变量（携带候选价值的陈述优先于仅凭近期性判断的陈述）、用于计数问题的候选项枚举与数量汇总，以及粒度/单位和事件锚点规则（合同 v3.4-facts-20260831）。 脚手架是带有代码内耦合不变量的代码，这些不变量会在内部出现不一致时触发异常。 该脚手架仅读取数据包和问题，因此被设计为对“黄金答案”不知情且独立于问题ID；其源代码已存档（§8）。 脚手架规则集以操作符形式进行版本管理（v3.3、v3.4）；§5.3中的层级结构用于在不同版本间切换。

paragraphs.en: 4.3 Negative controls at the improvement layer. Every proposed improvement runs against a 60-row control set of baseline-correct questions (58 of them correct in both passes of the grok-4.6-high pair, the incumbent when the gate ran) before integration. One stage failed it: a verifier stage that recovered 3 previously-wrong rows was rejected because the control replay showed it flipped 11 of 58 correct drafts to wrong (§6.2). The frozen acceptance rule — zero control flips — blocked it from ever touching the headline, while the xhigh reader variant (§5.1) passed that same 60-row control with zero flips before its full pair was launched.
paragraphs.zh: 4.3 改进层中的负对照。 每个拟议的改进方案在集成前，都必须与一个包含 60 行的基线校正问题对照集进行对比（其中 58 道题在 grok-4.6-high 配对的两次处理中均为正确，这也是该网关运行时的现行方案）。 有一个阶段未能通过测试：一个验证器阶段原本恢复了 3 个此前错误的答案行，但因对照重播显示它将 58 个正确草案中的 11 个改为了错误答案而被拒绝（§6.2）。 冻结的接受规则——即不允许任何对照翻转——阻止了它接触到标题内容，而 xhigh 阅读器变体（§5.1）在完整配对启动前，已通过相同的 60 行对照且未出现任何翻转。

paragraphs.en: 4.4 Self-consistency tie-break (built, then withdrawn). The raw pair’s spread came from eight verdict-flip rows, and a tie-break rule frozen before any additional read gave each flip row three more reads with a five-vote majority. The resulting number was withdrawn from any claim: internal review showed the construction wrote one derived verdict into both passes (an identity, not two agreeing measurements) and its flip-row selection was judge-conditioned. The artifacts remain released as a record; no self-consistency number is claimed anywhere in this report.
paragraphs.zh: 4.4 自洽性决胜机制（已构建，后撤回）。 原始配对的差异来自八行判决翻转，而任何额外读取之前就已固定的决胜规则为每行翻转结果增加了三次读取，并采用五票多数原则。 由此得出的数值被从任何主张中撤回：内部审查显示，该构建过程将同一个派生判决写入两次传递（这是一个恒等结果，而非两个相互一致的测量值），且其翻转行的选择受判决条件影响。 这些人工产物仍作为记录发布；本报告的任何部分均未声称存在自洽性数值。

paragraphs.en: The xhigh variant is a measured regression ( − 15 -15 / − 9 -9 ), reported in full. Its sessions also looked outside their prompts, some of them for the answer; §7 reports what they reached and shows that the regression survives removing every row whose answering session did so. Its gate evidence had looked favorable — a 25-row probe on the high pair’s wrong set recovered 9, and a 60-row negative control on baseline-correct rows showed zero flips — but the full pair exposed the gates’ limits: only 4 probe recoveries held, and the true correct-row flip rate ( ∼ \sim 3.4%) was small enough that a 60-row control had a ∼ \sim 13% chance of showing zero flips. Row-level attribution of pass 1’s 20 losses: 4 are judge flips on a final answer identical to the high run’s; the other 16 are reader losses, 15 of which share one over-skepticism signature — wrong abstentions on answerable rows, over-filtered counts, hedged golds. In the xhigh configuration, the reader second-guessed correct evidence. (One v1 verdict was a staleness artifact, not a reader loss: the reader resumed one row eleven minutes after the judge had scored it on an empty response; a surgical v2 re-judge under fresh 12/12 controls restored it, 460 → 461 460\to 461 ; the high run also missed that row, so the repair adds a gain and removes no loss.)

paragraphs.en: On identical packets and scaffolds: Claude Opus 479/475 ; grok-4.6-high 476/474; GPT-5.6 Sol ( openai/gpt-5.6-sol ) 455 — a row-level decomposition in the release attributes its gap to the 468 it scored under the earlier f3value scaffold set: − 5 -5 per-run reader variance on byte-identical non-scaffold rows, − 5 -5 negative scaffold × \times reader interaction, − 3 -3 abstention ( 468 − 13 = 455 468-13=455 ); judge controls 12/12 and 12/12. DeepSeek V4 Pro scores 436/500 (407/470 answerable), 43 below the top, with the best abstention behavior of any reader measured (29/30). A 30B floor probe (Nemotron-3.5-Lightning) collapses to 93/500 on the identical packets — the chain does not rescue a reader below a capability threshold. We controlled for a serving artifact: Nemotron fails even on the smallest packets (about 27% correct in the smallest packet-size quartile vs. 15% in the largest; V4 Pro, for comparison, about 90% vs. 84%), and a question-first re-prompt of a failed row was still ignored in favor of distractor-session content — the collapse is model-side, not provider truncation. A gemini-3.7-flash run reached a 189-row partial (a type-ordered prefix, not a sample: single-session-user 64/64, multi-session 73/83, preference 21/30, plus 12 abstention rows, all correct; no other types) and is reported as a partial run. A GLM-5.3 run on the identical substrate scores 471/500 (445/470 answerable, 26/30 abstention; official GPT-4o judge, controls 12/12) — a single-pass curve datapoint per the two-pass rule, not a headline. A Kimi K3 run (the long-context-specialist family) scores 465/500 (444/470 answerable, 21/30 abstention; same judge, controls 12/12) — in this single pass, the long-context specialist lands mid-curve. Together the fixed substrate exposes a full reader-capability curve (93 → \to 436 → \to 455 → \to 465 → \to 471 → \to 476 → \to 479): on identical packets, reader choice moves the score by up to 386 points across capability tiers but at most 14 among the four strongest reader models (465–479, counting each model once; the regressed xhigh configuration of grok-4.6 scored 461) and 24 if Sol (455) is included. Among strong readers the spread is narrow; below that tier, reader capability decides the score (the ladder in §5.3 is a build history, so this is not a component attribution). The v3.4 scaffold contract is tuned to the grok reader family (§7).

paragraphs.en: 6.2 The verifier our own control rejected. paragraphs.en: 6.3 Gold-answer defects (1 strict, 7 boundary). Documented row-by-row in the released dossier. The strict defect (class B): gold says “15 weeks” between two user-dated events that are 81 days (11 weeks 4 days) apart; wrong in all four passes of both reader configurations. Boundary — the $720 workshop row (published as strict; reclassified after re-auditing the released packet): gold requires a $500 workshop fee, and the user states it (session answer_826d51da_2 , 2023/02/26 13:37, “I paid $500 to attend”), so nothing has to be invented to reach gold. What is disputed is window membership: both dated mentions place the workshop on March 15–16, after the 2023/02/26 question date, attended in the past tense. The grok reader excludes the fee and answers $220 → \to 0 in both passes; the headline Opus reader includes it and answers $720 → \to correct in both passes; a weaker gemini-3.7-flash probe likewise included it and was scored correct. The judge rewards including the out-of-window item because gold includes it — the disclosed window-inclusion point inside 479/475 (§5.1), not a fabrication point. Six further rows are boundary-semantic (defensible readings on both sides); we claim nothing for them. One earlier strict candidate was downgraded to boundary after an independent-reader control showed the intended referent was answerable by premise repair. The Chronos authors independently document a defect on question 6d550036 (their §3.5, alongside a judge-variability example on 75f70248 ). Our dossier does not list that row, although it is wrong in all four Opus and grok passes; we have not classified it.
paragraphs.zh: 6.3 黄金答案缺陷（1个严格缺陷，7个边界缺陷）。 在已发布的档案中逐行记录。 严格缺陷（B类）：黄金答案指出两个由用户标注日期的事件之间间隔“15周”，而实际间隔为81天（11周4天）；在两种阅读器配置的四次处理中均判断错误。 边界缺陷——价值720美元的工作坊那一行（最初被归类为严格缺陷，在重新审计已发布数据包后重新分类）：黄金答案要求工作坊费用为500美元，而用户也明确说明（回答_826d51da_2，2023/02/26 13:37，“我支付了500美元参加”），因此无需额外虚构内容即可符合黄金答案。 存在争议的是时间窗口归属问题：两个标注日期的提及都将工作坊置于3月15日至16日，即2023/02/26的提问日期之后，且均以过去时态描述其参加经历。 Grok阅读器排除了该费用，并在两次处理中均回答为220美元→0；而标题级别的Opus阅读器则将其包含在内，并在两次处理中均回答为720美元→正确；一个能力较弱的gemini-3.7-flash探针同样将其包含在内，并被判定为正确。 评审员奖励了包含该跨窗口项的做法，因为黄金答案本身也包含了它——这是第479/475节（§5.1）中披露的窗口包含要点，而非虚构得分点。 另有六行属于边界语义问题（双方均可提出合理解释）；我们对此不作任何主张。 此前一个严格缺陷候选项在经独立阅读器验证后被降级为边界缺陷，因为验证表明其预期指代内容可通过前提修正得到解答。 Chronos的作者独立记录了问题6d550036中的一个缺陷（见其§3.5，同时附有75f70248上的评审员差异示例）。 我们的档案中未列出该行，尽管它在所有四次Opus和Grok处理中均判断错误；我们尚未对其分类。

paragraphs.en: 6.4 Retrieval ceiling and coverage, measured precisely. One row’s gold never reaches the candidate pool; three rows lost an in-pool gold session to packet budget ordering (no global ordering recovers them without losing more). paragraphs.en: Reader-context audit. Only the headline Opus lane disabled the built-in tools ( claude -p --tools ’’ ); that flag does not cover tools from MCP servers, and the runner did not disable them. That lane was not a clean completion either: each call ran as a Claude Code session and also received the operator’s global instruction file, memory index, session-start hook output and MCP server instructions; the transcripts record about 59,000 to 62,000 characters of this text per call, in addition to the packet prompt. The complete outbound requests were not retained, so what else each request carried, including whether any MCP tool was offered to the model, cannot be established after the fact. Across the 1,000 scored answers the transcripts record no tool call; none of the recorded text named this benchmark or carried another question, and no gold answer of 12 or more characters appears in it (248 of the 500 gold answers; shorter answers cannot be tested by string match, because short strings occur in any long text); we did not measure its effect on accuracy. The other lanes ran through agent command-line tools with tools available, and we audited the transcripts of every full run reported here. The grok-4.6-high pairs (Cursor agent, ask mode, empty workspace): of 2,538 chats, five called a tool, two of them attempts to look the answer up on the web; one was refused by the lane, one timed out, and no tool returned benchmark content. The OpenCode lanes (Sol, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3, Nemotron): the tool calls were almost all a workflow command injected by the operator’s global agent configuration, or the reader echoing its own answer; one Nemotron session searched the repository and found packet files. No tool call named an evaluation or gold-answer file, but these readers’ context carried operator instructions a clean lane would not. The xhigh pair (Grok CLI, tools enabled, eight turns) is not a closed-book measurement. For 12 pass-1 rows and 16 pass-2 rows, the session that produced the scored answer made a call outside its own prompt and workspace: 13 of these 28 only listed the tool’s session store while looking for their own prompt file; the others consulted the tool’s memory store (11), searched or read elsewhere on the filesystem (3), or searched the web (1), and that web search returned a public issue thread quoting the question’s expected answer.

sents.en: The OpenCode lanes (Sol, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3, Nemotron): the tool calls were almost all a workflow command injected by the operator’s global agent configuration, or the reader echoing its own answer; one Nemotron session searched the repository and found packet files.

sents.en: For 12 pass-1 rows and 16 pass-2 rows, the session that produced the scored answer made a call outside its own prompt and workspace: 13 of these 28 only listed the tool’s session store while looking for their own prompt file; the others consulted the tool’s memory store (11), searched or read elsewhere on the filesystem (3), or searched the web (1), and that web search returned a public issue thread quoting the question’s expected answer.

paragraphs.en: Dossier correction (the $720 row). The dossier originally classed the $720 workshop row as gold-unreachable without fabrication, on the claim that no $500 workshop fee appeared in the evidence; a mechanical re-audit of this release’s own published packets found that fee stated by the user, so the row is a boundary row (§6.3), the strict-defect count is 1 rather than 2, and the adjudication figures in §5.1 were recomputed. No verdict changed and the headline 479/475 is unaffected — only the classification of a row that was already scored as measured. The error and its correction are recorded in the dossier rather than removed from it.

paragraphs.en: Released with this report at https://github.com/cjchanh/longmemeval-evidence (MIT). A fresh clone verifies every RELEASE_MANIFEST.md row and re-derives every headline count from the released verdicts without an API key. The evidence commits on the title page anchor to the source tree the release was exported from. The release holds all reader outputs, judge verdicts and control receipts for every run in the ladder except the v3 rerank row (473), which is not in this release; the judge harness (frozen rubric, SHA-pinned templates, fail-closed transport), the tie-break rule and per-vote records, attribution tables, the gold-defect dossier, and run scripts. Re-scoring any run under the official judge costs ≈ $ 1.28 \approx\$1.28 and requires only an OpenAI API key. The released/held boundary is frozen in RELEASE_MANIFEST.md (one SHA-256 per released file, regenerated deterministically by scripts/build_release_manifest.py ): released are all reader checkpoints, judge verdicts, control receipts, agreement matrices, the dossier, the judge harness with its tests and rubric source, and the reader-lane scripts; held are the retrieval, rerank, packet-compiler and scaffold-operator sources. Also not in this release are the session transcripts and the audits computed from them for §7 (per-call model ids, operator-context sizes, the gold-string scan outputs, and the identifiers of the 28 excluded xhigh rows). The materialized packets and the v3.4 scaffolds the headline pair consumed are released under eval/dense_chain_v32_20260830/packets_materialized/ (gzip; sha256 in its MANIFEST.md ), and scripts/materialize_packets.py re-derives every packet byte-for-byte from the released allocation and the MIT benchmark data, so a third party can re-run stage 5 (reader) on the released packets and scaffolds and re-run the judge on the saved answers. The headline reader’s complete input context cannot be reconstructed (§7). The held stages ship as pinned artifacts with verification receipts (determinism, gold-permutation, question-ID-sabotage, budget gates); the released verdict totals and judge-control results are re-derivable from the released checkpoints and harness alone; the transcript-derived analyses of §7 are author-reported. The benchmark data is MIT-licensed ( xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned ), so the released checkpoints may carry question and gold text.
paragraphs.zh: 随此报告一同发布，地址为 https://github.com/cjchanh/longmemeval-evidence（MIT 许可）。 一次全新克隆会验证 RELEASE_MANIFEST.md 中的每一行，并基于已发布的裁决结果重新推导出所有标题计数，无需 API 密钥。 标题页上的证据提交锚定至发布版本所导出的源树。 该发布版本包含每次阶梯运行中所有读者输出、裁判裁决和控制收据，但 v3 重排序行（473）除外，该行未包含在此发布版本中；此外还包括裁判框架（固定评分标准、通过 SHA 锁定的模板、故障终止传输）、决胜规则、每票记录、归属表、黄金缺陷档案以及运行脚本。 使用官方裁判对任何运行进行重新评分的成本约为 $1.28 \approx\$1.28，且仅需一个 OpenAI API 密钥。 已发布与保留内容的边界在 RELEASE_MANIFEST.md 中已固定（每个已发布文件对应一个 SHA-256 哈希，由 scripts/build_release_manifest.py 脚本确定性再生成）：已发布的内容包括所有读者检查点、裁判裁决、控制收据、一致性矩阵、档案、包含测试和评分标准源代码的裁判框架，以及读者流程脚本；保留的内容则包括检索、重排序、包编译器和脚手架操作员的源代码。 会话转录及据此计算的 §7 审计结果也未包含在此发布版本中（包括每次调用的模型 ID、操作员上下文大小、黄金字符串扫描输出，以及 28 个被排除的 xhigh 行的标识符）。 已生成的数据包以及标题对所使用的 v3.4 脚手架均发布在 eval/dense_chain_v32_20260830/packets_materialized/ 目录下（gzip 压缩；sha256 哈希位于其 MANIFEST.md 中），且 scripts/materialize_packets.py 脚本能根据已发布的分配信息和 MIT 基准测试数据逐字节重新生成每个数据包，因此第三方可基于已发布的数据包和脚手架重新运行第 5 阶段（读者），并对保存的答案重新运行裁判。 无法重构标题读者的完整输入上下文（§7）。 保留的阶段以带验证收据的锁定工件形式提供（包括确定性、黄金排列、问题 ID 破坏测试和预算门限）；已发布的裁决总数和裁判控制结果仅通过已发布的检查点和框架即可重新推导得出；而 §7 中基于转录的分析结果由作者自行报告。 基准测试数据采用 MIT 许可（xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned），因此已发布的检查点可能包含问题和黄金答案文本。

paragraphs.en: How should leaderboards report results inside the judge’s noise? The top entries now differ by fewer questions than one judge flips on byte-identical answers (§4.2, §8). Releasing per-question verdicts (which makes paired tests such as McNemar computable), repeated judging to estimate the flip floor, and multi-judge agreement are candidate reporting standards; which of them makes a ranking at this margin meaningful is open.
paragraphs.zh: 排行榜应在判定的噪声范围内如何报告结果？ 当前排名靠前的条目之间，差异的题目数量已少于一个判定在字节完全相同的回答上发生翻转的次数（§4.2、§8）。 按每道题发布判定结果（这使得麦尼默等配对测试变得可计算）、通过重复判定来估计翻转下限，以及多判定一致性，都是潜在的报告标准；在这些标准中，哪一种能使这一差距下的排名具有实际意义，仍有待探讨。

paragraphs.en: The deterministic retrieval chain, with an LLM confined to a replaceable reader, places every gold session in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and measures 479/475 per 500 on LongMemEval-S, bracketing the published 478/500. On the same fixed packets, reader choice moves the score from 93 to 479, and the four strongest readers land within 14 points of one another. A pre-committed negative control rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct ones. The scoring-prompt deviation, judge variance, reader conditions, and same-set development leave superiority and equivalence unestablished, and held stage sources limit method reproduction; the released packets and verdicts make the measurement itself inspectable. A held-out evaluation with a pinned reader and complete request capture is the next test of transfer (§9).
paragraphs.zh: 这种确定性检索链将大型语言模型（LLM）限制在可替换的阅读器中，使所有黄金会话都进入 468/470 个可回答问题的候选池，并在 LongMemEval-S 上测得 479/475（满分 500），接近已公布的 478/500。 在相同的固定数据包上，更换阅读器使分数从 93 提升至 479，而性能最强的四种阅读器之间的分差不超过 14 分。 一种预先设定的负对照实验拒绝了一个验证器：该验证器修复了三个错误草案，却破坏了十一个正确草案。 评分提示的偏差、评估者的差异、阅读器的条件以及同一数据集的开发过程使得优劣性和等效性尚未确立，而预留测试阶段的资源也限制了方法的复现；不过，已发布的数据包和判决结果使测量过程本身具备可验证性。 下一项迁移能力测试（§9）将采用预留的评估集，并使用固定阅读器与完整的请求捕获机制。
